headline: Lake Erie beat Tiffin to finish top of the table
dek: The leaders have won every conference match since drawing at Tiffin in October, and closed their season with the rematch at home on Tuesday. Thomas More, level second with a match still to play, lost at Kentucky Wesleyan the same evening and can no longer reach Lake Erie's points total.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is level across the upper half and falls away at the foot: Lake Erie's 36 are more than Northwood and Ohio Dominican have scored together.

wire.line: Lake Erie have won every conference match since their draw at Tiffin, and no one can now catch them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tiffin have drawn six matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept nine clean sheets for Tiffin.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have won one match all season, drawn five and lost eleven.

findings.text: Tom Woodward has scored twelve goals for Ashland from 70 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jersey Lopez has twelve assists for Kentucky Wesleyan.

last_match.line: Tiffin's only other conference defeat came at Cedarville, the last side to beat Lake Erie.

next_match.line: The sides drew without a goal here earlier this month; Findlay have lost both their matches since.
